title: OM (O.M - Operation Mole; Dhanush, Mammootty, Sai Pallavi; dir. Rajkumar Periasamy) trailer out; in cinemas worldwide Fri 20 Nov 2026; Tamil, Telugu, Hindi confirmed
headline: OM Brings Dhanush and Mammootty Together on 20 November
caption:
OM, the action drama that puts Dhanush and Mammootty on screen together, opens in cinemas worldwide on Friday 20 November. Its full trailer is out now.

The trailer shows Dhanush going undercover in a red-sandalwood smuggling ring run by Mammootty's character. Sai Pallavi plays officer Nithya Reddy, who leads the operation the film is named after. Sreeleela, Naseeruddin Shah and Indrans also star.

Rajkumar Periasamy, who made Amaran, directs, with music by Sai Abhyankkar. Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios produce. Tamil, Telugu and Hindi versions are confirmed, and PEN Marudhar is releasing it across North India. The film was first set for 16 October and moved to avoid a clash with Rajinikanth's Jailer 2.

Sources: Variety India, Sacnilk, DT Next, Cinema Express, The Hans India
